messages:
Lena Park: Heads-up: enterprise customer tightened asks — they want route-level cost leaderboard, a way to jump to relevant traces, and an error-slice breakdown that surfaces suspect spans. Need to agree scope for the 3-week demo.

Noah Kim: High level: leaderboard + trace link is the demo bar. Error-slice explorer is M2. Also need a plan for showing live vs batched numbers.

Sara Venkataraman: UX: demo must be crisply onboarding-friendly. Show top 10 routes, a small note on accuracy, and a prominent Trace link per row. No deep filters for the demo.

Omar El-Sayed: Backend constraints: two options — lightweight sampling attribution (fast, estimated) or full attribution (accurate, heavy). Estimates: sampling path ~3d infra + 2d backend; full path ~8d + infra ops.

Priya Kapoor: Ops: rollout policy — canary to 10% orgs, monitor 5xx delta and tail latency. No automatic rollback. If 5xx +0.6% over baseline, pause and investigate.

Lena Park: Proposed acceptance for demo: 1) leaderboard accuracy >=80% for top-10 (marked "estimated") 2) Trace links resolve >=95% for sampled items 3) dashboard P95 <2.5s for demo dataset. Sound okay?

Noah Kim: 80% is reasonable for sampling. We'll include a coverage footer showing what percent of requests had cost tags.

Sara Venkataraman: UI columns: Route | Est Cost % | 99p Latency | 5xx rate | Trace. Add small badge "estimated" and an info popover that explains sampling and limitations.

Omar El-Sayed: Implementation plan: Sprint A (canary/demo): sampling-based attribution, trace-link plumbing, coverage metric, org-level only. Sprint B: improve attribution accuracy, error-slice detail page, per-region opt-in.

Priya Kapoor: Runbook entries: 1) metric to watch: obs_cost_coverage and obs_5xx_delta; 2) action: disable sampling flag and revert canary if 5xx delta >0.6% sustained 30m; 3) contact list. I'll add to runbook.

Lena Park: Tradeoffs: cut per-tenant and per-user breakdowns for demo, and no long retention. Customer demo only asked per-route — good cut?

Noah Kim: Good cut. Also propose showing both "24h pre-agg" and "live 5m est" columns to set expectations. Live est label must say "computed from sampled requests".

Sara Venkataraman: Agree. Mock: two-column view helps with trust. I'll sketch the mock and attach to PRO-820.

Omar El-Sayed: Extra infra note: add a cheap circuit breaker so live-est compute can be disabled automatically if CPU delta crosses threshold. Flag name `obs_live_est_enabled`.

Priya Kapoor: I'll add that to ops checklist and set alert thresholds. Also recommend synthetic traces for public demo to avoid PII.

Lena Park: Timeline: lock M1 demo scope today: leaderboard (org-level, estimated costs, 99/5xx, trace link), coverage footer, sampling flag, two-column live/pre-agg view. Tickets: PRO-820 (Demo leaderboard), PRO-821 (Sampling + trace plumbing), PRO-822 (Runbook + alerts). Assign owners tomorrow.

ops-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2025-04-07 03:00-05:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent. :rocket:

Noah Kim: I'll open PRO-820 and tag Omar + Sara. If infra blocks sampling, fallback to static synthetic samples for demo.

Sara Venkataraman: I'll prepare demo copy for the info popover and a short script for the customer walk-through.

Lena Park: OK locking demo scope. Demo date target 4/21 — don't overrun. Thanks team."
